sources.description: In a surprise to probably no one, the top position choice by a pretty big margin for Broncos fans looking toward the NFL Draft was inside linebacker. No doubt this is a position of need for Denver in many respects. The Broncos re-signed their veteran linebackers this offseason — Alex Singleton and Justin Strnad. But […]
